applyLink.description: The link to apply to the job posting. Will be to the public job board if the job posting is on an external job board, or to the internal job board if the job posting is on an internal job board.

departmentName.description: The name of the department associated with the job posting

employmentType.description: The employment type for the job posting

isListed.description: Whether or not the job posting is listed

jobId.description: The id of the job associated with the job posting

secondaryLocationIds.description: The secondary location ids for the job posting

locationName.description: The name of the primary location associated with the job posting

shouldDisplayCompensationOnJobBoard.description: Whether the job posting's settings specify that compensation should be shown to applicants when the posting is listed among other job postings

teamName.description: The name of the team associated with the job posting. `teamName` and `departmentName` will be the same if the team does not have a parent team specified.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the job posting was last updated
